project_adapter.purpose: extract generic call-frame and hook mechanics from the forbidden bytecode executor and own the strict AOT metadata, frame, static-module, materialized-constant, table, iteration, and method-dispatch ABI

bytecode_boundary.aot_frame_location: CallInfo.aotstate low 20 bits; zero is unknown and currentpc remains opaque
bytecode_boundary.aot_frame_continuation: CallInfo.aotstate high 12 bits; zero means no resumable continuation

coverage_patch.behavior: routes lua_getcoverage over bytecode-free AOT Protos to state-local immutable-site counter records

resolved_excluded_executor_symbols.resolution: conditional ldo dispatch patch routes AOT entry to luauc_runtime_v1_enter
conditional ldo dispatch patch routes yielded-op completion to luauc_runtime_v1_finish_yielded_op

notes: The declared set compiles into a 36-member wasm32 relocatable archive: 34 retained upstream translation units, one project call-frame adapter, and the required empty Zig root object.

archive_built_unlinked means standard relocatable objects exist; generated functions, profile-provided protected-call hooks, libc, the provider adapter, and any entry adapter are separate normalized-pack inputs.

The project adapter owns the versioned strict-AOT program metadata, rooted Proto constant materialization, plain table-template cloning, append mutation, direct table method dispatch, and one table-valued __index prototype method lookup, packed native-frame source location and continuation state, frame entry, fixed and open-result return, variadic frame preparation and retrieval, zero-upvalue, one-direct-value-upvalue, and one-reference-upvalue closure materialization, open/closed UpVal access and mutation, fixed and open-argument/result compiled calls, a GC-rooted static-module registry that caches successful exports, retries failed initializers, explicitly rejects active cycles, and caches the entry-module result, plus the Proto teardown ABI.
lvmutils.cpp remains because it owns reusable value, table, comparison, arithmetic, concatenation, length, loop, and metamethod helpers.

luaV_getimport remains trapped in forbidden VM/src/lvmload.cpp and general imports remain unsupported; exact safe-environment-proven literal require clusters are instead resolved to closed-package module IDs and call luauc_runtime_v1_require_static.
